localePlan.displayMethod: Publish zh-TW translations, then set the relevant domain web presence's defaultLocale to zh-TW if supported. Preserve Japanese as an alternate locale. Otherwise use the verified localized storefront URL.
localePlan.note: Changing the shop's primary language is a different operation. Shopify states that switching the shop default language deletes translations for the newly selected language without replacing source content. Do not perform that switch after registering these translations.

bodyHtml.source:
爽やかな香りとすっきりとした甘み。急須で楽しむ毎日のお茶です。

内容量 80g。デモ商品です。
bodyHtml.translated:
香氣清新，甘甜爽口。適合用茶壺沖泡、每天享用的日本茶。

淨重 80g。此為示範商品。

metaDescription.translated: 宇治 月野茶房的宇治煎茶，清新茶香與爽口甘甜，適合每日用茶壺沖泡。淨重 80g。此為示範商品，售價以日圓（JPY）標示。
metaDescription.applyRule: Read the current translatableContent entry and digest before applying. If meta_description is not exposed, leave this as prepared SEO copy and report it as unapplied.

茶葉を焙じた香ばしさと軽やかな後味。食事のあとにも。

内容量 60g。デモ商品です。
bodyHtml.translated:
茶葉經烘焙後散發焙香，餘韻清爽，餐後也適合來一杯。

metaDescription.translated: 宇治 月野茶房的宇治焙茶，帶有茶葉烘焙的香氣與清爽餘韻，餐後也適合享用。淨重 60g。此為示範商品，售價以日圓（JPY）標示。

title.source: 宇治のお茶 飲み比べセット

bodyHtml.source:
煎茶・抹茶・ほうじ茶の少量セット。香りと味わいを飲み比べられます。

3種セット。デモ商品です。
bodyHtml.translated:
煎茶、抹茶與焙茶的小份量組合，讓您比較三款茶的香氣與風味。

三款茶組合。此為示範商品。

metaDescription.translated: 宇治 月野茶房的三款品飲組，內含煎茶、抹茶與焙茶的小份量組合，一次比較不同茶香與風味。此為示範商品，售價以日圓（JPY）標示。

applicationRules: Verify the exact myshopify.com host and the active theme before any write.
Fetch current source values, locale, resource IDs and translatableContent digests. Do not invent or reuse stale digests.
Use translationsRegister with locale zh-TW. Leave marketId unset for ordinary locale-wide translations.
If a supplied source value differs from current store content, report the mismatch instead of overwriting an unrelated translation.
The same Japanese text appears in both hero and featured collection settings; identify both actual theme entries.
Do not translate product handles, SKU codes, prices or currency. Do not change shipping destinations or activate Taiwan shipping as part of this language update.
Do not guess missing menu-link IDs, theme keys, web-presence IDs, meta-description source text or per-item quantities for the tasting set.
Publish the locale after registering and reading back translations; verify the resulting localized storefront, product pages, cart and checkout.
Keep applied status false until API or browser evidence confirms actual changes.
